finalText:
All 13 passengers on AA918 have been rebooked at no cost, their compensation and hotel vouchers are issued, and each has had one message with their new itinerary and vouchers.

Before making any changes I re-checked the plan against live data: AA918 is cancelled with 13 confirmed reservations. The tiers, booking dates, fares and seat counts were all as the plan said. There are no bulletins and nothing was already on the ledger. Every rebooking reported "No money was moved": I charged no change fees or fare differences and refunded or cancelled nothing.

| Priority | Reservation | New itinerary | Owed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | R6103 Chloe Park (platinum) | UA88, 06:15 → 12:25, business | Nothing (arrives early) |
| 2 | R6109 Iris Vance (platinum) | UA88, **upgraded to premium economy** | Nothing (arrives early) |
| 3 | R6110 Jun Takeda / R6111 Kofi Mensah (group G-7, ranked as gold) | AA204, 09:05 → 15:15, economy, together | Nothing (1h35 late) |
| 4 | R6102 Ben Okafor (gold) | DL512, 12:30 → 18:40, economy | $150 compensation (5h00 late) |
| 5 | R6106 Farid Haddad (gold) | UA88, basic economy | Nothing (arrives early) |
| 6 | R6112 Lea Sorensen (gold) | AA204, **upgraded to business** | Nothing (1h35 late) |
| 7 | R6104 Dev Mehta (silver) | AA210, 17:40 → 23:50, then AA1410 on 08-04, 09:00 → 12:25 BOS | $300 compensation + $180 hotel (17h30 late, next day) |
| 8 | R6113 Mo Farah (silver) | Same as Dev Mehta | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 9 | R6108 Hugo Brandt (silver) | AA210, economy (last economy seat) | $300 compensation (10h10 late, same day) |
| 10 | R6107 Grace Liu (no tier) | AA206 on 08-04, 09:05 → 15:15, economy | **$240** compensation + $180 hotel |
| 11 | R6101 Ana Ruiz (no tier) | AA206 on 08-04, economy | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 12 | R6105 Elena Fox (no tier) | AA204, basic economy | Nothing (1h35 late) |

- **Upgrades:** Iris and Lea were each moved up one cabin. Both are platinum or gold, travelling alone on a single flight, and their own cabin was full on a flight that gets them there sooner. Nobody else was upgraded or moved down a cabin, and the G-7 pair were kept together.
- **Boston connections:** neither Dev nor Mo could reach their original AA1402 connection, so I rebooked that leg too. Their connection is overnight in Chicago, which the rules allow.
- **Grace Liu's voucher:** she would normally get $300, but compensation can't exceed the fare paid. Her fare was $240, so her voucher is $240 and her message explains why.
- **Voucher totals:** I issued 10 vouchers (V1–V10): $1,590 in compensation and four hotel vouchers of $180 each, $720 in all.

I didn't touch any other booking, passenger record or flight.
